Hello!

Only 6 days left to Full Release of The Mims Beginning!
We are very excited, we have been developing our game so long time. This will be huge day for us. There will be a discount for first week Of Release. We really would to make as biggest traffic as we can during first days of Release it is important for us to be visible on Steam.

You could help us with this by just to clicks, We created thunderclap campaign. You could join it by click "Support with FACEBOOK (or Twitter)" then "Add my Support"  

THUNDERCLAP CAMPAIGN HERE

It will help us a lot. Why?
Thunderclap is well know and safe platform to mass audience. It means that if you'll add your support by Facebook then few hours after game Release (18th of May) it will post on your Facebook, one and only one time short message about our game Release and link to steam. More supporters means bigger help for us on first hours of Release.
We are making promotion only with our hands without budget so it will be great if you could support us right there.

notes.title: Full Release on the 18th of MAY - Trailer Video - Pre Release Update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/337820/ss_d34b41e15221c8b1d7130c614eeea61514072862.600x338.jpg?t=1461851362
Hi everyone,
The Squatting Penguins team here.

After spending 4 years on making The Mims Beginning in our small team we'd like to present to you a launch trailer for the game's release on the 18th of May.

WATCH FULL RELEASE TRAILER HERE 

It is truly incredible how a indie game, as opposed to triple-A titles, can get recognition thanks to the kindness of people like you. There's been plenty of ups and downs and we have managed to finish two crowdfunding raises on wspieram.to and indiegogo. A simple 'thank you' won't ever convey the gratitude we feel towards you. You helped immensely us by playing the game, providing feedback or simply encouraging us. The "pre-release" update for the game is already available on Steam. This version is the final version; the only possible changes would concern the difficulty optimization and bug removal. (maybe adding some very small features also)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/337820/ss_4450493bd850d28a75db3cdf71380463eafac590.600x338.jpg?t=1461525798

The games has much more features than we initially planned. This project was supposed to take 6 months, but ultimately took over 4 years to complete, no small feat for such a tiny team. We have always been honest and implemented every feature we promised. Unfortunately we were unable to include a save system which would allow to save the game in any place. We didn't promise such a feature, but based on your requests we tried to make it work. We spent 2 months on it but came up empty. The game was in such an advanced state that implementing this save system was virtually impossible. We do hope that all the improvements and balancing on the gameplay we made, as well as the inclusion of various difficulty levels will make the game much better and more fun to play. It goes without saying that the progress is saved after each mission.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/337820/ss_19405228b01f32f6b49df23310fcc9546d9c709a.600x338.jpg?t=1461525798

There are so many changes and additions in the current update, so let's just point out the main ones:

- 5 additional levels (including 3 levels with bosses), a final level with two ways to end the game and two different endings.

- Difficulty levels. Doesn't matter if you're a hardcore gamer or just simply want to experience the story - now you'll find 4 difficulty levels for everyone to enjoy.

- Overall optimization: each aspect of the game has been overhauled to make the gameplay more fun. All the bugs have been removed. The levels can be finished much quicker if that is what you're going for.

- The sandbox/survival mode has been optimized, specifically the random event frequency.

- Group creation and the Mims AI has been overhauled.

- Hotkeys have been added.

- The icing on the cake: Steam achievements.

- soon there will be Italian language version for sure (and we hope spanish too)
 

All right, that’s enough babbling from us. Just pick up the game and see for yourself. Have fun!
P.S You remarks and bug reports are still very important
________________________

notes.title: Beta 1.0 hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Hello
Yesterday Linux and Mac players reported that there was a problem with "DNA Ball" mission. We fixed it.

FIXED:
-The problem was that disintegrator didn't work, so even if clock showed 0:00, next level didn't load. We Fixed that problem. This problem was present only on 64bit systems. Now you can proceed with your gameplay.

IMPROVED:
-We've made some slight changes of Camera controls. Now Q,E is rotating view, and R,T is for zooming. Keep in mind that that we are still working to improve Camera controls, this is only change of keys setting.
________________________________________________

The game will update automatically.

Thank you for cooperation and remarks.
Squatting Penguins Team
